cardEffects:
[Main] 1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a level 5 or higher Digimon card with the [Free] trait in your hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 4. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When one of your Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted other than by one of your effects, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・By digivolving that Digimon into a Digimon card with [Imperialdramon] in its name in your hand without paying the cost, prevent that deletion.
name: Return to the Primogenitor

rulings.answer: No, this card's [Main] effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
rulings.question: When I use this card's [Main] effect to digivolve into a level 5 or higher Digimon card with the [Free] trait in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

rulings.answer: No, this card's ＜Delay＞ effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
rulings.question: When I use this card's ＜Delay＞ effect to digivolve into a Digimon card with [Imperialdramon] in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

rulings.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] would be deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> effect after using this card's ＜Delay＞ effect to digivolve?

rulings.answer: No, you can't activate it.  BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect can't be activated because it doesn't trigger when the Digimon is deleted by an opponent's effect.
rulings.question: When BT16-025 [Paildramon] is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's ＜Delay＞ effect to digivolve?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> and this card's ＜Delay＞ effect will trigger simultaneously, and the triggered <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> on BT16-025 [Paildramon] can be activated, even if you use this card's effect to digivolve first.
rulings.question: When a Digimon with BT16-025 [Paildramon] in its digivolution cards is deleted by an opponent's effect, can I activate BT16-025 [Paildramon]'s <Partition (blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4)> inherited effect after using this card's ＜Delay＞ effect to digivolve?

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  1 digivolution can only be performed on 1 Digimon. You can't perform separate digivolutions on multiple cards at the same time.  Therefore, when multiples of your Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted other than by one of your effects, you can only use this card's effect to digivolve 1 of those Digimon.  In addition, only the digivolved Digimon is prevented from being deleted.
rulings.question: If I activate this card's [All Turns] effect when multiples of my Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted at the same time other than by one of my effects, can I digivolve all of those Digimon and prevent them from being deleted?

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  Only the turn player can attack.  In this case, your EX3-063 [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode] can't attack because it isn't your turn.
rulings.question: [All Turns] When my Digimon with the [Free] trait would be deleted other than by one of my effects during my opponent's turn, I used this card's [All Turns] effect to digivolve that Digimon into EX3-063 [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode].  Can I then use ＜Blitz＞ in EX3-063 [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode]'s [When Digivolving] effect to attack?

securityEffect: [Security] You may play 1 Tamer card with [Davis Motomiya] or [Ken Ichijoji] in its name from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
